title: Flask using Python
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Flask, a lightweight and powerful Python web framework used for building web applications and RESTful APIs. Participants will learn how to develop scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using Flask’s core features, including routing, templates, database integration, authentication, and deployment. Through hands-on projects, learners will gain practical experience in developing full-stack web applications using Flask and integrating them with modern frontend frameworks.
audience: Python Developers looking to expand into web development
Backend Developers seeking expertise in Flask for API development
Full-Stack Developers interested in lightweight web frameworks
Software Engineers working on microservices and web applications
Students & Professionals aspiring to become web developers
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Building Flask applications from scratch
Live Demonstrations – Implementing Flask features in real-time
Case Studies & Real-World Examples – Understanding best practices
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions and pair programming
Capstone Project – Developing a fully functional Flask-based web application
competencies: Building Dynamic Web Applications using Python & Flask
Database Integration with Flask SQLAlchemy & SQLite/MySQL
Developing RESTful APIs using Flask-RESTful & Flask-RESTX
Deploying Flask Applications on Cloud Platforms
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand Flask’s architecture and core components
Build dynamic web applications with Flask routes and templates
Work with databases using Flask SQLAlchemy ORM
Develop RESTful APIs using Flask-RESTful & Flask-RESTX
Implement authentication and user management in Flask applications
Optimize Flask applications for performance and scalability
Deploy Flask applications to production environments
